tasks.short: Turn business, technical, accessibility and privacy constraints into a feasible website design plan.

steps.what: Gather the brief, architecture decision, policies and existing site measurements.
Translate the brief and policies into requirements with source references.

loop.input: Approved brief, policies and architecture decision.
loop.output: Draft requirements with source passages, owners and unresolved questions.
loop.check: Require a source for each requirement; designer checks omissions and interpretation.
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction pass; unresolved requirements return to their owners.
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative briefs and policy exceptions cannot reliably be mapped with fixed fields alone.

steps.what: Inspect existing pages for performance, device compatibility and detectable accessibility issues.
Calculate delivery costs and capacity using estimates supplied by technical colleagues.
Agree scope, performance targets and budget tradeoffs with business and technical owners.
Review privacy implications and accessibility obligations requiring specialist interpretation.
Compile the technical design plan and obtain technical acceptance.

tasks.design: A job on the {DATA_PLATFORM} gathers evidence from {DOCS}, {PROJECT} and the {CMS}; a bounded extraction loop drafts a source-linked requirements register. Deterministic checks and cost calculations assemble the technical design plan in {DOCS}, with separate business, specialist and technical approval points.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requirements were scattered across prose, technical estimates and policies. Templates existed, but collecting evidence and preserving traceability needed bespoke integration.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding can reduce the effort of building connectors, calculations and report templates. Bounded extraction can prepare narrative requirements for review; no universal speed multiplier is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Budget tradeoffs, realistic estimates and legal interpretation remain contextual. Automated accessibility checks cover only part of accessibility.
tasks.human_edge: The designer makes constraints understandable and negotiates a usable experience within them.

ambition.what: Reassess page-weight and interaction budgets at each major design revision.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from assembling documents to resolving conflicting constraints earlier. The designer can propose scope changes with evidence; budget and compliance approval rights stay with their owners.

reach.task: Compare campaign scope against website delivery capacity.
reach.learn: Scenario costing, uncertainty ranges and commercial prioritisation.

evidence.claim: Requirements registers, formula-based costing and scheduled technical checks are feasible deterministic building blocks.
GitHub Copilot supports code completion and review, providing build assistance rather than evidence of this workflow's savings.
Developer productivity studies report differing outcomes, so a fixed acceleration factor is not justified.

assumptions: A mid-size company has identifiable business, engineering and compliance owners, sometimes supported externally.
The {OTHER} slot in site inspection denotes browser testing and audit tools.
GDPR and the EU AI Act apply where relevant; this workflow does not rate employees.
Consent and access estimates include permissions and national employee consultation where the implementation requires it.
unknowns: Which policies and accessibility requirements apply to the website.
Whether budgets, technical estimates and site measurements are available in reusable formats.
Who may accept technical constraints and compliance findings.
Whether the proposed data access or monitoring requires employee consultation under national rules.
research_questions: Which requirements recur sufficiently to become mandatory form fields?
Which accessibility and privacy questions consistently require specialist review?
new_work: Review extracted requirements and missing-source warnings.
Maintain cost assumptions, check thresholds and policy versions.
Resolve connector failures and changed document permissions.

tasks.short: Compare website architecture and technology options, test important claims, and record a selection.

steps.what: Agree selection criteria, constraints and situations that justify changing the existing architecture.
Read technical documentation and record evidence for shortlisted options.

loop.input: Dated documentation for a human-selected shortlist and explicit selection criteria.
loop.output: Evidence table with source passages, versions, limitations and missing facts.
loop.check: Check source existence and dates automatically; designer verifies decisive claims.
loop.stop: One pass per shortlisted option and one correction pass; unsupported claims remain unknown.
loop.why_not_simpler: Technical documentation expresses comparable capabilities in inconsistent prose and structures.

steps.what: Compare costs and supported capabilities in a weighted options table.
Build small technical trials and measure uncertain compatibility or performance claims.
Choose an option considering maintainability, team skills, uncertainty and switching costs.
Record the architecture decision, rejected alternatives and review triggers.

tasks.design: A comparison service on the {DATA_PLATFORM} reuses approved evidence in {DOCS} and extracts cited facts from shortlisted documentation through a bounded loop. Deterministic scoring and repeatable benchmarks produce a decision pack; after the engineering lead selects an option, a template records the architecture decision and review triggers in {DOCS} and {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research was repeated for each project, while versions, assumptions and comparisons became stale. Building reusable technical trials required engineering time.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding makes small benchmark harnesses and evidence pipelines cheaper to build. Bounded extraction reduces reading time without delegating technology selection.
tasks.still_hard: A numerical score cannot settle maintainability, team capability or future migration cost. New architectures still need bespoke trials.
tasks.human_edge: The designer and engineering lead distinguish attractive capabilities from options the team can sustain.

ambition.what: Make a quarterly retain-or-replace decision for campaign-site architecture.

tasks.altitude: The designer spends less time reformatting research and more time testing uncertain claims. They can recommend reopening a decision when evidence changes; architecture approval stays with the engineering lead.

reach.task: Assess architecture effects on crawlability and page performance.
reach.learn: Rendering behaviour, measurement validity and search-related technical constraints.

evidence.claim: Evidence tables, explicit scoring and repeatable benchmark harnesses can be built deterministically.
GitHub Copilot offers coding assistance and review with human oversight.
Trials involving 4,867 developers reported more completed tasks; this does not establish equivalent gains in architecture selection.

assumptions: The {OTHER} slots denote a web browser for documentation and a development environment for trials.
Benchmarks run in isolated environments with synthetic or approved sample content.
The comparison uses an explicit shortlist rather than open-ended autonomous research.
Access estimates include national employee consultation if new workplace monitoring is introduced.
unknowns: Which technology decisions the designer can recommend or approve.
Whether an approved technology catalogue and representative test scenarios exist.
Which procurement, licensing and security constraints are mandatory.
research_questions: Which criteria can be measured reproducibly rather than scored subjectively?
What changes should invalidate an existing architecture decision?
new_work: Verify decisive source claims and refresh expired evidence.
Maintain benchmark environments and representative workloads.
Review scoring weights and explain exceptions to the ranking.

tasks.short: Agree e-commerce priorities with management and users, then translate them into website changes.

steps.what: Export sales, funnel and customer enquiry evidence for the strategy discussion.
Reconcile reporting periods and calculate journey drop-off and commercial baselines.
Discuss buying barriers and proposed journeys with users.
Combine research and commercial evidence into opportunities and explicit hypotheses.

loop.input: Aggregate metrics, minimised research notes and commercial goals.
loop.output: Opportunity brief separating observations, hypotheses and unanswered questions.
loop.check: Reference evidence for observations; verify numbers against the baseline and review interpretations.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction pass; unsupported hypotheses remain explicitly untested.
loop.why_not_simpler: Qualitative barriers need interpretation across varied user accounts.

steps.what: Agree target journeys, commercial priorities and acceptable tradeoffs with management.
Translate agreed journeys into website requirements, acceptance criteria and success measures.

loop.input: Approved strategy decisions, technical constraints and requirement templates.
loop.output: Draft change brief with traceable acceptance criteria and measurement proposals.
loop.check: Map every requirement to an approved decision; designer verifies scope and measurable outcomes.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction pass; conflicting requirements return to the strategy owner.
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative strategy decisions do not fully specify interaction behaviour or acceptance criteria.

steps.what: Configure approved website changes and release them after acceptance checks.
Review early outcomes against the baseline and recommend the next adjustment.

tasks.design: Connect the {ECOMMERCE}, {CRM} and {BI} through the {DATA_PLATFORM} to produce consistent commercial baselines. Bounded loops draft evidence briefs and website requirements in {DOCS} and {PROJECT}; people conduct user conversations and agree strategy. Existing {CMS} and {ECOMMERCE} approval flows release supported configuration changes, then {BI} reports outcomes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reporting definitions differed across teams, and strategy decisions were disconnected from implementation briefs. User research and management alignment required sustained personal involvement.
tasks.enabler_now: Small integrations can standardise evidence, while bounded drafting carries approved decisions into delivery artefacts. Existing publishing controls can connect acceptance to release.
tasks.still_hard: Commercial causality, conflicting incentives and understanding buying barriers remain difficult. Bespoke checkout logic or cross-system commerce changes need additional engineering.
tasks.human_edge: The designer earns trust, recognises what users cannot articulate and negotiates commercial choices without sacrificing usability.

ambition.what: An assisted product-selection journey for customers facing complex purchase choices.

tasks.altitude: The week contains less report reconciliation and more user research and outcome review. The designer can propose journey experiments with clear success measures; pricing, budget and release approval remain with existing owners.

reach.learn: Contribution margin, fulfilment constraints and purchase-funnel measurement.

reach.task: Evaluate whether a journey change caused an observed commercial improvement.
reach.learn: Experiment design, sampling bias and causal inference.

evidence.claim: Data reconciliation, reporting and controlled publishing can use deterministic integrations and configured workflows.
Interviews and negotiated commercial priorities retain substantial human work despite automated preparation.
The digest provides no documented case establishing automation gains for e-commerce strategy collaboration.

assumptions: The company operates an online sales journey and has usable aggregate commercial reporting.
The release step covers changes supported by existing templates and configuration.
Research participation has an appropriate GDPR basis, clear notices and suitable retention.
Access estimates include national employee consultation where staff research or monitoring changes require it.
The proposed assisted-selection service requires validation before investment.
unknowns: Whether sales, funnel and enquiry metrics use compatible definitions.
Whether existing publishing workflows support staging, approval and rollback.
Which proposed changes require custom development.
Whether customers need assisted product selection.
Who approves commercial experiments and public website releases.
research_questions: Which buying barriers combine strong user evidence with meaningful commercial impact?
Which outcome measures distinguish better purchasing decisions from short-term conversion changes?
new_work: Review generated briefs for unsupported conclusions and scope changes.
Maintain metric definitions and investigate incomplete exports.
Manage research consent, retention and participant recruitment.
Review release exceptions and interpret experiment outcomes.

tasks.short: Create and test website prototypes covering interfaces, interactions, logic and representative data.

steps.what: Clarify the prototype's audience, target journey and questions to test.
Define entities, relationships, journey states and interaction rules.
Sketch layout alternatives in an {OTHER} visual design tool.

loop.input: Prototype brief, approved component catalogue, model and brand constraints.
loop.output: Structured layout alternatives using permitted components and explicit interaction states.
loop.check: Validate component references and required states; designer selects and edits the layout.
loop.stop: At most two alternatives and one correction pass; fall back to an approved layout pattern.
loop.why_not_simpler: Novel information hierarchy and spatial composition are not fully specified by reusable templates.

steps.what: Construct responsive screens and connect interactions in the {OTHER} prototyping environment.
Exercise sample data, screen sizes and interaction states using {OTHER} browser testing tools.
Observe users attempting representative tasks and discuss confusing interactions.
Resolve important findings and revise the prototype in the {OTHER} prototyping environment.
Package the prototype, interaction notes and unresolved questions for development.

tasks.design: A prototype generator on the {DATA_PLATFORM} combines an approved component library with a designer-defined model and selected layout. A bounded loop proposes layouts; deterministic assembly, synthetic data and browser checks produce a private interactive prototype in an {OTHER} prototyping environment. User sessions remain human, while {DOCS} and {PROJECT} receive a generated handover from the reviewed prototype.
tasks.previous_blocker: Design tools made drawing efficient, but responsive behaviour, realistic states and handover still required repeated manual construction. Design assets and data models often lacked a shared structure.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding makes component renderers, schema-based sample data and browser checks cheaper to build. Bounded layout drafting helps where the brief leaves visual choices open.
tasks.still_hard: Original interaction design, ambiguous domain models and accessibility beyond automated checks need skilled judgment. A prototype cannot establish production security, scalability or integration correctness.
tasks.human_edge: The designer decides what to explore, notices user confusion and creates coherent interactions rather than merely plausible screens.

ambition.what: Include screen-reader users in early interactive prototype testing.

tasks.altitude: The designer spends more of the week exploring alternatives and observing users, with less repetitive screen assembly. They can choose which prototype hypotheses to test; production architecture and release decisions remain with existing owners.

reach.task: Turn brand direction into reusable interface components.
reach.learn: Responsive behaviour, design tokens and accessible component states.

reach.task: Specify interaction behaviour and error messages for implementation.
reach.learn: State modelling, concise interface language and task-based documentation.

evidence.claim: Component-based assembly, schema-derived sample data and generated handover documents are deterministic techniques.
Playwright Test Agents can draft test plans and tests and repair failing tests; generated tests still require validation.
GitHub Copilot provides code generation assistance that can help build prototype tooling.

assumptions: The {OTHER} slots denote visual design, modelling, prototyping and browser testing tools.
An approved component library exists or can be scoped to a small initial set.
Prototype data is synthetic and the prototype is privately shared.
Build estimates cover a reusable generator for one component family, not an entire design system.
Access estimates include participant consent arrangements and national employee consultation where applicable.
unknowns: Whether existing design components have usable code equivalents and export interfaces.
Which physical deployment, interface, logic and data models each project actually needs.
Whether the prototype environment supports meaningful assistive-technology testing.
Whether representative research participants can be recruited.
Which modelling and design changes require engineering review.
research_questions: Which repetitive prototype states can be generated without constraining useful design exploration?
Which usability questions require realistic data or working interactions to answer?
new_work: Review generated layouts and missing interaction states.
Maintain component mappings, synthetic data rules and browser checks.
Recruit research participants and manage consent and findings.
Keep prototype limitations and unresolved implementation questions visible.

role.altitude: The role shifts toward framing design questions, testing evidence and negotiating experience tradeoffs. Faster preparation and construction support stronger recommendations; budget, compliance, architecture and public release authority remain explicitly assigned.
reach: Work with the marketing manager on evidence-based scope and investment choices.
Work with the online merchant on purchase journeys and commercial outcomes.
Work with the search marketing strategist on rendering, crawlability and performance.
Work with the graphic designer and technical writer on reusable, accessible interactions.
skills_to_grow: Component systems, interaction states and data modelling.
User research, experiment design and commercial measurement.
Validation of model-generated drafts and maintenance of deterministic tooling.
role.ambitious_version: Run a small experience-validation service that joins commercial evidence, accessible prototypes and technical feasibility before teams commit to website development.
